readings.title: The Vow of the Nazirite
readings.subtitle: Separation and Dedication to the Creator
readings.text: [Numbers 6:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, and say to them, ‘When a man or woman does separate, by making a vow of a Nazirite, to be separate to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,</dq> [3] <dq>he separates himself from wine and strong drink – he drinks neither vinegar of wine nor vinegar of strong drink, neither does he drink any grape juice, nor eat grapes or raisins.</dq> [4] <dq>All the days of his separation he does not eat whatever is made of the grapevine, from seed to skin.</dq> [5] <dq>All the days of the vow of his separation a razor does not come upon his head. Until the days are completed for which he does separate himself to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, he is set-apart. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.</dq> [6] <dq>All the days of his separation to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> he does not go near a dead body.</dq> [7] <dq>He does not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother or his sister, when they die, because his separation to <dn>Elohim</dn> is on his head.</dq> [8] <dq>All the days of his separation he is set-apart to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [9] <dq>And when anyone dies beside him in an instant, suddenly, and he has defiled the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing – on the seventh day he shaves it.</dq> [10] <dq>And on the eighth day he brings two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Appointment,</dq> [11] <dq>and the priest shall prepare one as a sin offering and the other as an ascending offering, and shall make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead body. And he shall set apart <dn>את</dn> his head on that day,</dq> [12] <dq>and shall separate to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>את</dn> the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old, as a guilt offering. But the former days are not counted, because his separation was defiled.</dq> [13] <dq>And this is the Torah of the Nazirite: When the days of his separation are completed, he is brought to the door of the Tent of Appointment,</dq> [14] <dq>and he shall bring <dn>את</dn> his offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: one male lamb a year old, a perfect one, as an ascending offering, and one ewe lamb a year old, a perfect one, as a sin offering, and one ram, a perfect one, as a peace offering,</dq> [15] <dq>and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened thin cakes anointed with oil, and their grain offering with their drink offerings.</dq> [16] <dq>And the priest shall bring them before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and prepare <dn>את</dn> his sin offering and <dn>את</dn> his ascending offering.</dq> [17] <dq>And he shall prepare <dn>את</dn> the ram as a slaughtering of peace offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, together with the basket of unleavened bread. And the priest shall prepare <dn>את</dn> its grain offering and <dn>את</dn> its drink offering.</dq> [18] <dq>And the Nazirite shall shave <dn>את</dn> the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Appointment, and shall take <dn>את</dn> the hair from the head of his separation and shall put it on the fire which is under the slaughtering of the peace offerings.</dq> [19] <dq>And the priest shall take <dn>את</dn> the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened thin cake, and put them upon the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved <dn>את</dn> his hair of separation.</dq> [20] <dq>Then the priest shall wave them, a wave offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. It is set-apart for the priest, besides the breast of the wave offering and besides the thigh of the contribution. And afterwards the Nazirite shall drink wine.’</dq> [21] <dq>“This is the Torah of the Nazirite who vows to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> the offering for his separation, and besides that, whatever else his hand is able to provide. According to the vow which he takes, so he shall do according to the Torah of his separation.”</dq>

readings.title: The Priestly Blessing
readings.subtitle: Placing the Divine Name Upon Israel
readings.text: [Numbers 6:22] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [23] <dq>“Speak to Aharon and his sons, saying, ‘This is how you bless <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl. Say to them:</dq> [24] <dq>“<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> bless you and guard you;</dq> [25] <dq><dn>YeHoVaH</dn> make <dn>His</dn> face shine upon you, and show favour to you;</dq> [26] <dq><dn>YeHoVaH</dn> lift up <dn>His</dn> face upon you, and give you peace.” ’</dq> [27] <dq>“Thus they shall put <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Name on the children of Yisra’ěl, and <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> shall bless them.”</dq>

readings.title: The Two Silver Trumpets
readings.subtitle: Gathering the Assembly and Sounding the Alarm
readings.text: [Numbers 10:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Make two silver trumpets for yourself, make them of beaten work. And you shall use them for the gathering of the congregation and for breaking <dn>את</dn> camp.</dq> [3] <dq>“And when they blow both of them, all the congregation shall meet before you at the door of the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [4] <dq>“And if they blow one, then the leaders, the heads of the thousands of Yisra’ěl, shall gather to you.</dq> [5] <dq>“And when you blow a shout, the camps that lie on the east side shall depart.</dq> [6] <dq>“And when you blow a shout the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall depart – they blow a shout for them to depart.</dq> [7] <dq>“And when the assembly is to be assembled, you blow, but do not shout.</dq> [8] <dq>“And the sons of Aharon, the priests, blow with the trumpets. And it shall be to you for a law forever throughout your generations.</dq> [9] <dq>“And when you go into battle in your land against the enemy that distresses you, then you shall shout with the trumpets, and you shall be remembered before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, and you shall be saved from your enemies.</dq> [10] <dq>“And in the day of your gladness, and in your appointed times, and at the beginning of your new moons, you shall blow the trumpets over your ascending offerings and over your slaughterings of peace offerings. And they shall be a remembrance for you before your <dn>Elohim</dn>. <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: Departure from the Wilderness of Sinai
readings.subtitle: The Order of the Marching Camps
readings.text: [Numbers 10:11] And it came to be on the twentieth day of the second new moon, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from above the Dwelling Place of the Witness. [12] And the children of Yisra’ěl departed, setting out from the Wilderness of Sinai. And the cloud dwelt on it in the Wilderness of Paran. [13] Thus they departed the first time, according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> by the hand of Mosheh. [14] And the banner of the camp of the children of Yehuḏah departed first according to their divisions. And over their army was Naḥshon, son of Amminaḏaḇ. [15] And over the army of the tribe of the children of Yissasḵar was Nethan’ěl, son of Tsu‛ar. [16] And over the army of the tribe of the children of Zeḇulun was Eliyaḇ, son of Ḥělon. [17] And the Dwelling Place was taken down. And the sons of Gěrshon and the sons of Merari departed, bearing the Dwelling Place. [18] And the banner of the camp of Re’uḇěn departed according to their divisions. And over their army was Elitsur, son of Sheḏěy’ur. [19] And over the army of the tribe of the children of Shim‛on was Shelumi’ěl, son of Tsurishaddai. [20] And over the army of the tribe of the children of Gaḏ was Elyasaph, the son of De‛u’ěl. [21] And the Qehathites departed, bearing the set-apart objects, while <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place was set up before they came. [22] And the banner of the camp of the children of Ephrayim departed according to their divisions. And over their army was Elishama, son of Ammihuḏ. [23] And over the army of the tribe of the children of Menashsheh was Gamli’ěl, son of Peḏahtsur. [24] And over the army of the tribe of the children of Binyamin was Aḇiḏan, son of Giḏ‛oni. [25] Then the banner of the camp of the children of Dan, which formed the rear guard of all the camps, departed according to their divisions. And over their army was Aḥi‛ezer, son of Ammishaddai. [26] And over the army of the tribe of the children of Ashěr was Paḡ‛i’ěl, the son of Oḵran. [27] And over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Aḥira, the son of Ěnan. [28] Such was the order of setting out of the children of Yisra’ěl, according to their divisions, when they departed.

readings.title: The Ark Leads the Way
readings.subtitle: Seeking a Resting Place for Israel
readings.text: [Numbers 10:29] And Mosheh said to Ḥoḇaḇ, the son of Re‛u’ěl the Miḏyanite, Mosheh’s father-in-law, “We are setting out for the place of which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said, ‘<dq><dn>I</dn> give it to you.</dq>’ Come with us, and we shall do good to you, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has spoken good concerning Yisra’ěl.” [30] And he replied to him, “I am not going, but I am going to my own land and to my relatives.” [31] Then he said, “Please do not leave us, because you know how we are to camp in the wilderness, and you shall be our eyes. [32] “And it shall be, when you go with us, then it shall be that whatever good <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> does to us, the same we shall do to you.” [33] So they set out from the mountain of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> on a journey of three days. And the ark of the covenant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> went before them for the three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them. [34] And the cloud of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was above them by day when they went out from the camp. [35] And it came to be, whenever the ark set out, that Mosheh said, “Rise up, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! And let <dn>Your</dn> enemies be scattered, and let those who hate <dn>You</dn> flee before <dn>You</dn>.” [36] And when it rested, he said, “Return, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to the countless thousands of Yisra’ěl.”
